issues.description: Milkable.messageOnMilk() return type mismatch: The problem statement (UML and textual requirements) specifies Milkable.messageOnMilk() returns a String and describes a String return like "[Animal Type] [name] is milked". The template Main prints the return value (System.out.println(m.messageOnMilk())), which also expects a printable message String. The solution repository declares Milkable.messageOnMilk() with return type boolean and Seal/Goat implementations print the message internally and return boolean. This inconsistency forces students to choose between implementing the interface as documented (String) or as in the provided solution (boolean), causing confusion and potential test/compilation mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the interface and implementations with the problem specification: change Milkable.messageOnMilk() signature to return String (e.g. String messageOnMilk()). Update Seal and Goat to return the specified String (e.g. "Seal Clarabelle is milked" / "Goat Buttinsky is milked") instead of printing and returning boolean. Leave Main as-is (it already prints the returned String). This preserves the UML/textual contract and avoids printing side-effects inside implementations.
